title: Eludite agents settings
description: The ACP agents a user adds to the Agents window, in `agents.json` in Eludite's config directory (`<user config dir>/eludite/`, or ELUDITE_CONFIG_DIR). They follow the built-in ones (the native Claude Code adapter, then the npx adapter) in the window's agent list. Any ACP agent speaking JSON-RPC on stdio works.

default.description: The name of the agent the window selects at start.

command.description: The executable (a path, or a name looked up on PATH).
